svg.aria-label: A routing bench on two separate bases. The larger Cloudflare bench contains a Workers control chassis, D1 ledger drawers, a private R2 archive, a private validation gate and queue magazine. Across an open gap, external Telnyx fax, Pingen print and post, and Resend email machines receive authorized provider submissions.
